summary: Iteration 19 backend + frontend verification for Custom-Lists Settings and 12-hour Digest scheduler. All 9 backend pytest cases passed (defaults, PUT roundtrip w/ case-insensitive dedupe + empty removal, 40/60-char clamping, reset, auth-required 401/403, and user isolation). All 6 frontend checks passed on mobile viewport 390x844: Custom Lists nav present in Profile, settings screen renders Break Types + Priority Flags with settings-back, add flow creates 'Coffee run' as break-row-4, top-right Save button appears and no console errors after save, Digest scheduler shows 'Hour (1-12)' label (no '0-23'), AM/PM pressable toggle works and live preview updates from '8:00 AM' to '8:00 PM' on PM tap.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2344 lines and growing. Consider splitting into routers (auth, settings, reports, weather, digest) to stay under the 700-line guideline.

PUT /settings/lists has no explicit maximum list length; a client could submit thousands of break types. Consider capping len(break_types) and len(priority_flags) (e.g., 40 each) to protect the collection.

GET /settings/lists returns is_default=false whenever a doc exists — even if the persisted lists are empty. Consider treating empty stored lists as default too, or preventing PUT from persisting fully-empty payloads.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 executed checks; delete flow SKIPPED as documented — web window.confirm not interactable via Playwright)

seed_data_creation: Created ~4 short-lived TEST_it19_* users during runs; all deleted via /api/admin/users cleanup in fixtures. No persistent seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) in /app/frontend/.env; export it or set both. New endpoints: GET/PUT /api/settings/lists and POST /api/settings/lists/reset backed by MongoDB collection 'user_settings'. Frontend routes: /profile/settings (Custom Lists) and /admin/digest (Weekly Digest w/ 12-hour scheduler). Test admin credentials: admin@paintops.com / Admin@12345. Delete flow uses window.confirm on web, so Playwright can't interact — record as SKIPPED as instructed.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All specified checks completed successfully.
